content_sections.heading: IIM Tiruchirappalli Corporate Engagement Executive Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The institute has notified a total of 6 vacancies for the Corporate Engagement Executive post.

content_sections.heading: IIM Tiruchirappalli Corporate Engagement Executive Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates must be citizens of India. Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English with the ability to engage senior decision-makers. Self-starter with strong interpersonal skills and demonstrated persistence in lead conversion. Willingness to travel extensively (10–15 days/month across metro cities). IT and AI proficiency.

rows.qualification_required: A Bachelor's Degree from a recognised University/Institute. A postgraduate degree (MBA or PGDM) in Marketing, HR, Business Analytics, or General Management is preferred. Post-qualification experience in business development, campus placements, corporate HR, or B2B sales is preferred.

content_sections.heading: IIM Tiruchirappalli Corporate Engagement Executive Age Limit
content_sections.text: The upper age limit is 45 years , determined as on the closing date of the application (November 02, 2026).

content_sections.heading: IIM Tiruchirappalli Corporate Engagement Executive Selection Process
content_sections.text: The shortlisted candidates have to appear for the Selection Process that may include a written test/skill test, and an interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IIM Tiruchirappalli Corporate Engagement Executive
content_sections.text: Read the notification and confirm eligibility before applying through the Institute’s online recruitment portal at https://www.iimtrichy.ac.in/careers-non-teaching . Fill out the prescribed application form available online within the prescribed period. Upload complete and legible documents supporting age, educational qualifications, experience, and applicable category/reservation claims along with a recent passport-size colour photograph and signature. Submit the application successfully through the online portal on or before 05.00 pm on November 02, 2026. Retain a printout or PDF of the final application for future use.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: SSLC/10th certificate or equivalent proof of date of birth HSC/Class XII certificate, where applicable UG/PG degree/diploma certificates and relevant mark sheets Experience certificates and salary certificates, wherever required Recent passport-size colour photograph and signature Valid photo identity proof Any other document required to support the information furnished in the application
